model: DeBERTa-v3-base fine-tuned for aspect-category sentiment, with one attention query per aspect (Week 3), decision settings tuned on validation (Week 4), isotonic score calibration (Week 5)
training_data: EduRABSA (Hua et al., 2025; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): 5,998 public English course and teacher reviews, mapped to 8 aspects (dataset v1.1-edurabsa); 4,198 train / 900 validation / 900 test
intended_use: Course-level summaries of anonymised feedback for coordinators and faculty; advisory only
out_of_scope: Any decision about an individual student or staff member
Languages other than English (Hinglish is not supported)
known_failure_modes: Hinglish / code-switched comments are mostly missed
Neutral and mixed (conflict) opinions are often read as positive or negative
Negative comments about a teacher can add a spurious teaching:negative
Long reviews (80+ words) score lower; minor aspects get missed
Names without any title are not redacted; emails written with spaces are redacted only in report quotes

test_results.split: test, 900 comments, never used for any decision
